metaDescription: Calculate your maximum mortgage, buyer's closing costs and mortgage interest deduction, and compare annuity vs linear repayment. Live DNB/ECB rates and 2026 lending norms.
introTitle: How much can you borrow — and what does it cost?
introCopy: Enter your monthly salary. You'll instantly see what you can borrow, what it costs each month, and which one-off costs come on top. Expand details and charts whenever you like.
introNote: A calculation sketch, not advice. Banks often apply stricter criteria.
loginToSave: to keep your mortgage on your account.
loginToSync: to keep your calculation in sync across devices.
step1Lead: Enter your monthly salary. Holiday pay is included by default; a 13th month and bonus can be added on top.
selfEmployedWarning: With less than 12 months of self-employment, most banks exclude this income or barely count it.
debtLeaseHint: The full monthly cost counts against your budget.
debtRevolvingHint: Even if you don't use it.
step2Hint: Choose your fixed-rate period. The starting rate follows current DNB/ECB figures; adjust it if you have a quote.
rateHintShort: Starting rate around {rate}%. Because you fix for less than 10 years, we test against the statutory minimum of {floor}.
rateHintMarket: Current market rate {rate}% (DNB/ECB new residential mortgages, {asOf}{extra}). Not a bank offer.
rateHintFallback: Indicative starting rate {rate}%. Adjust it once you have a quote.
nhgCheck: NHG: often a slightly lower rate, only up to {limit}
fundsHint: This increases what you can buy, not necessarily what you may borrow.
debtsFallback: Lease, student loan or other obligations
debtsHint: Add whatever applies — a lease of a few hundred euros can make a difference of tens of thousands.
studentRemainingMode: I only know the remaining balance
energyMeasuresCheck: Borrow extra for sustainability measures (only usable for energy savings)
starterExemptionCheck: I believe I qualify for the first-time buyer exemption (0% transfer tax)
epgCheck: Energy performance guarantee of at least 10 years
resultPlaceholderCopy: Enter your monthly salary. Holiday pay is included by default.
nhgCappedBanner: Capped by the 2026 NHG cost ceiling ({limit}). Based on income, {uncapped} could be possible without NHG.
fitFitsRoom: This asking price fits. You have roughly {room} of headroom up to your maximum purchase price.
fitFits: This asking price fits within the calculated borrowing capacity.
fitTight: Tight: you are roughly {gap} short. Extra savings or a lower offer could close the gap. Maximum purchase price: {max}.
fitOver: This home costs {price}. Based on this sketch you could go up to {max} — {gap} short.
howCalculated: How did we arrive at this amount?
scenariosHint: Different labels, rates or obligations — relative to your current sketch.
startRateSource: Starting rate from {source}, {asOf}. No bank comparison.
startRateBuiltIn: The starting rate is a built-in indication until market rates load.
grossMonthlyHint: The amount before tax, as shown on your payslip.
grossAnnualHint: Usually including holiday pay. Add the 13th month and bonus separately below.
fixedAllowanceHint: Shift work, overtime or irregular hours, if structural.
variableBonusHint: Variable bonus: we take the 3-year average, capped at the most recent year.
intentCheck: I will receive a declaration of intent for permanent employment
yearsActiveLabel: How long have you been self-employed (years)?
dividendLabel: Dividend paid out, if you include it
balanceSubtitle: Annuity vs linear — same loan and rate
rateImpactSubtitle: Same loan, different rate (±1 percentage point)
ownFundsWithCash: {kk} buyer's closing costs + {cash} toward the purchase price
ownFundsInMortgage: {kk} buyer's closing costs · purchase price in the mortgage
ownFundsExplain: Mostly closing costs; the purchase price can be financed up to 100%
grossUntilIncome: Gross, until you enter your income
lessInterestLinear: less interest with linear over {years} years
appearsWithLoan: Appears once there is a loan amount
costsSummaryEmpty: Enter an asking price for the breakdown
noAskingPriceHint: Without an asking price we cannot calculate transfer tax and deeds. The charts below use your maximum mortgage.
refundRateUnknown: {rate} max rate until your income is known
refundViaReturn: . Via your tax return in the year of payment.
taxSummaryEmpty: Enter your income for the net calculation
taxExplanation: Deduction rate {rate}. Of the {costs} in deductible purchase costs you get roughly {refund} back. On top comes the interest benefit; the imputed rental value of {ewf}/year is added to that.
taxEmptyHint: With an income we calculate the maximum deduction rate, imputed rental value and net monthly payment.
linearHigher: Linear starts higher ({linearPayment} vs {annuityPayment}) but you pay {delta} less interest.
compareEmptyHint: Enter an income or asking price to compare the repayment types.
lineRefundNote: Via your tax return you get roughly {refund} of this back.
